description: Raise fixes for OSV vulnerabilities, hold npm releases for three days, and pin third-party GitHub Actions behind dashboard approval. The release age comes from Renovate's `security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm`, which leaves out the update types that carry no release timestamp; a global `minimumReleaseAge` would hold those back forever.

packageRules.description: Pin `github-action` digests. As per GitHubs [security best practice](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/security-hardening-for-github-actions#using-third-party-actions). This preset has to come after `group-non-major` in `default.json`: packageRules apply in order, so a later rule's `groupName` would pull these Actions back into the non-major group, and the whole group would then inherit `dependencyDashboardApproval` and wait for an approval nobody gives.
